title: Camera-enabled scalable homodyne detection of multimode quantum light
summary: Scalability is a key challenge in advancing quantum technologies such as quantum computing, communication, and metrology. Photonic systems offer a promising route to scalability by enabling the deterministic generation of large-scale entangled states. Homodyne detection is an essential quantum measurement to exploit such entangled states, enabling quantum-enhanced measurement, deterministic quantum teleportation, GKP-state breeding, and quantum error correction.
